name: The Allstate Corporation
business: US personal property & casualty insurer (auto, homeowners) plus protection products.

news.title: Q2 adj. net income $8.99/share (+46%); $1.0B buyback in the quarter

pros: Large buybacks ($2.6B left on the $4B authorization)
cons: Volatile catastrophe losses: Jul+Aug already $1.43B pre-tax
Auto-insurance pricing tailwind may fade as margins normalize
take: Cheap, cash-returning insurer at peak profitability; cats and a softening pricing cycle are the risks.

metrics.summary: The Allstate Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides property and casualty, and other insurance products in the United States and Canada. It operates in four segments: Allstate Protection; Run-off Property-Liability; Protection Services; and Corporate and Other.
